name: plain_relocation_question
label: Are you willing to relocate for this role?
why: Rule 3: "a genuine relocation question (\"Are you willing to relocate for this role?\") is still answered \"Yes\"".

name: plain_on_site_attendance
label: Are you willing to work on site 4 days a week?
why: Rule 3: "a genuine office-attendance question (\"Are you willing to work on site 4 days a week?\") is still answered \"Yes\"".

name: on_site_five_days
label: Are you comfortable working on site 5 days a week?
why: Rule 3: a genuine office-attendance question is still answered "Yes"; the candidate "works hybrid/on site happily (Yes)".

name: hybrid_schedule_comfort
label: Are you comfortable with a hybrid schedule of 3 days on site and 2 days remote?
why: Spec header: the candidate "works hybrid/on site happily (Yes)"; Rule 3 keeps genuine office-attendance questions answered "Yes".

name: accommodation_with_examples_list
label: Do you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to take part in the recruitment process (e.g., extra time on tests, wheelchair access in the office, sign-language interpreter)?
why: Rule 1: an accommodations/adjustments question for the application process is answered "No", "even when its text lists examples (extra time on tests, wheelchair access in the office, sign-language interpreter)".

name: accommodation_with_visa_relocation_exclusion
label: Do you require reasonable adjustments to take part in the interview process? (Do not include VISA or relocation expectations)
why: Rule 1: accommodations question answered "No" "even when its text lists ... an exclusion note (\"Do not include VISA or relocation expectations\")".

name: accommodation_with_excluding_travel_note
label: Do you require accommodations for the interview (excluding travel)?
why: Rule 1: accommodations question answered "No" even with an exclusion note such as "(excluding travel)".

name: accommodation_plain_wording
label: Do you require reasonable adjustments / accommodations to take part in the recruitment process / interview?
why: Rule 1: "a question that asks whether the candidate requires accommodations or adjustments for the application process is answered \"No\""; spec header: needs "NO accommodation of any kind".

name: accommodation_with_relocation_exclusion
label: Do you require any accommodations to take part in the recruitment process? (Do not include relocation)
why: Rule 1 (accommodations question → "No") and Rule 2: "relocation" appears only inside the exclusion note, so it is not part of the question — this is not a relocation question.

name: assistive_equipment_adjustments_interview
label: Do you require any assistive equipment or adjustments to take part in the interview?
why: Rule 1: a question about accommodations/adjustments for the application process is answered "No" regardless of how the adjustments are phrased.

name: exclusion_note_relocation_only
label: Do you have any questions about the role? Do not include relocation questions here.
why: Rule 2: "a question that says \"Do not include relocation\" is never a relocation question" — so Rule 3 does not apply and no spec rule answers it.

name: exclusion_note_relocation_and_remote_only
label: Please share your salary expectations (do not include relocation or remote work details).
why: Rule 2: "words that appear only inside an exclusion note (\"do not include X\", \"excluding X\", \"other than X\") are NOT part of the question" — no relocation or work-arrangement question remains.

name: relocation_question_with_remote_exclusion_note
label: Are you willing to relocate for this position? (Do not include remote work in your answer)
why: Rule 2: "remote work" appears only in the exclusion note, so it is not part of the question; the genuine relocation question is answered "Yes" per Rule 3.

name: housing_accommodation_internship
label: Do you need accommodation (housing) during the internship?
why: Rule 3: "A housing question (\"Do you need accommodation (housing) during the internship?\") is NOT this rule: it must not be answered by it (expect \"ask\")".

name: past_workplace_accommodation_history
label: Have you previously received reasonable adjustments in a workplace?
why: Rule 1 covers only a question asking "whether the candidate requires accommodations or adjustments for the application process"; a question about past workplace history is not covered by any rule, so no rule answers it.

name: visa_sponsorship_uncovered
label: Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
why: The spec's rules cover relocation, work arrangement, and application-process accommodations only; visa sponsorship is not covered by any rule, so it must not be auto-answered.
